PAGE TITLE: MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS STRATEGIC GOALS AND HIGHLIGHTS
FY 2024 Performance Assessment

CHARTS:
- Title: Strategic Goals 1 through 4 Performance Ratings Comparison (FY 2023 vs FY 2024)
- Chart type: Stacked bar chart
- Units: Percentages (0% to 100%)
- Axes/Legend:
  - Vertical axis: percentages from 0% to 100% in increments of 10%
  - Horizontal axis: Strategic Goal 1, Strategic Goal 2, Strategic Goal 3, Strategic Goal 4 (with FY 2023 and FY 2024 bars for each)
  - Legend: Complete or On Target to Complete (Green), Below Target (Yellow), Significantly Below Target/At Risk (Red), Unrated (Grey)
- Labeled values by category and year/series:
  - Strategic Goal 1:
    - FY 2023: Unrated: 11; Complete or On Target to Complete: 5
    - FY 2024: Unrated: 10; Significantly Below Target/At Risk: 1; Complete or On Target to Complete: 3
  - Strategic Goal 2:
    - FY 2023: Below Target: 3; Complete or On Target to Complete: 7
    - FY 2024: Unrated: 1; Below Target: 1; Complete or On Target to Complete: 8
  - Strategic Goal 3:
    - FY 2023: Significantly Below Target/At Risk: 1; Below Target: 3; Complete or On Target to Complete: 7
    - FY 2024: Significantly Below Target/At Risk: 1; Complete or On Target to Complete: 10
  - Strategic Goal 4:
    - FY 2023: Significantly Below Target/At Risk: 1; Below Target: 1; Complete or On Target to Complete: 10
    - FY 2024: Significantly Below Target/At Risk: 1; Below Target: 1; Complete or On Target to Complete: 12

KEY FACTS:
- Throughout FY 2024, program officials assessed progress toward achieving NASA’s 50 Performance Goals and determined whether annual targets were met.
- Twelve Performance Goals supporting Strategic Goals remained unrated at the time of the FY 2024 AFR’s publication.
- Ten of those unrated goals are awaiting ratings from the Science Advisory Committees.
- Performance Goal 2.2.3 focuses on providing operational resources to enable the closure of capability gaps in support of deep space exploration.
- Performance Goal 4.2.8 focuses on increasing facility reliability for current and future mission needs through investments in preventative maintenance.
- For Strategic Goal 1 focusing on science, two Performance Goals were removed for FY 2024.
- One Performance Goal, formerly an Agency Priority Goal, was sunsetted when the James Webb Space Telescope became operational and no longer in development.
